data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 温泉旅馆的吃醋撒娇
data.description: 温泉旅馆榻榻米被褥上，吃醋喝了点甜酒的雪菜整个人扑在你的怀里。纯白睡裙滑散，她把发烫的脸蛋埋在你的颈窝里，带着哭腔与酒意软软地要求前辈发誓永远不离开她。
data.location: traditional ryokan tatami room with futon spread out
data.action: clinging tightly to partner chest on futon, camisole slipping down, flushed cheeks, demanding promises of love with teary eyes
data.lighting: warm paper lantern glow casting soft silhouettes on shoji screen
data.mood: tipsy possessive affection, disarmed vulnerability, sweet lovers warmth
data.promptProse: Clinging tightly to partner on a ryokan futon, Yukina blushes intensely with tears in her eyes, her camisole slipping off bare shoulders.
data.animaCaption: Clinging closely on the tatami futon with a tipsy jealous pout, warm lantern light traces her flushed cheeks.
